name: Blue Cash Everyday® Card

apr.notes: Terms list a 0% introductory APR for the first 15 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers; standard variable APRs are accurate as of 2026-07-16.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on other eligible purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is received as Reward Dollars redeemable for statement credits or eligible Amazon.com checkout purchases.

signup_bonus.description: Official terms describe a personalized welcome offer as high as $200 cash back; exact eligible amount is shown before accepting the Card if approved.

benefits.title: $84 Disney Streaming Credit
benefits.description: Up to $7 in monthly statement credits after qualifying purchases at eligible U.S. Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN streaming websites when enrolled.

benefits.title: $180 Home Chef Credit
benefits.description: Up to $15 in monthly statement credits for eligible Home Chef meal kit subscription purchases when enrolled.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for eligible purchases against covered loss events, subject to American Express benefit terms.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage on eligible rentals when the rental is paid with the card and coverage terms are met.

benefits.title: Cash Back at Amazon.com checkout
benefits.description: Reward Dollars can be linked and used for eligible items at Amazon.com checkout.

other: Global Assist Hotline coordination and assistance services are available at no additional charge; third-party service costs are the Card Member's responsibility.

notes: Product name Blue Cash Everyday is not a Network Tier; network_tier is none for Amex network packages. Welcome offer amount is personalized on the official terms page.
